text:
maya: Quick design UX/intl pass for Compliance > Data — caught a few interrelated nits around the encryption label, retention wording in UI + exports, and the region control tab order. Trying to batch fixes before the next release.
sam: drop the exact strings/screens please.
maya: current badge: 'Encrypted (KMS)'. tooltip: 'Data encrypted using customer-managed Key Management Service (KMS). Learn more about key rotation and access controls in the docs.' It wraps badly on narrow screens and reads awkwardly when SR reads parentheses.
rija: SR/i18n note: parentheses and acronyms break natural speech in some TTS engines and translated strings. For example French TTS will attempt to read acronyms differently. Suggest short visible label without parens: 'Encrypted — customer key' and keep 'KMS' in the docs page or a longer panel.
oliver: Accessibility/color: our green token measures ~2.8:1; fails AA for normal text. Option A: darker fill (#005f46) which hits 4.5:1. Option B: light chip with dark text + 1px border. I prefer darker fill to avoid layout flicker.
lina: Also the badge is currently non-interactive (span). Keyboard users and SRs don't find it. Make it a focusable element (button) and use aria-describedby to point to the explanatory panel. aria-label should be explicit: 'Encryption: customer-managed key. Press Enter for details.'
maya: For mobile, tooltip should become a bottom sheet with the longer explanation + link to docs. Use id kms-panel-194567 so we can reference in code and tests.
sam: noted. I'll implement button + bottom-sheet behavior. Any objections to the shorter label 'Encrypted — customer key'?
rija: +1. Keeps it clear and TTS-friendly.
maya: Second nit: retention input shows a number only (e.g., '90') and audit logs export CSV lines read 'Retention set to 90' — compliance team wants units and timezone context in exports. Also they asked for an optional 'reason' field when Admins change retention.
oliver: CSV export sample currently looks like:
```
actor,action,target,timestamp,details
jane,update_retention,org-123,2025-02-12T14:03:22Z,"Retention set to 90"
```
We should change details to: "Retention set to 90 days (reason: quarterly cleanup)" and export timezone as ISO with zone. Also include a separate column 'human_readable_change' for easy parsing.
lina: UI change: show unit inline next to the number (example: '90 days') and make the unit localizable. For RTL locales the layout should reverse properly.
maya: Good catch about RTL. Also ensure the audit panel preview shows the human-friendly string before export so compliance can sign off.
sam: I'll update templates and the CSV exporter. Plan: change audit message template to: 'Retention set to {n} days' and append reason if provided. Add column 'change_summary' to CSV. Also ensure timestamp uses zone offset instead of only Zulu if local timezone is required.
rija: Small accessibility detail: when retention is updated via the number+unit control, SR should announce both parts together. Use aria-live when change is confirmed: 'Retention updated to 90 days for organization example-org.'
maya: Third nit: region selector visual order is Region -> Retention but DOM order is reversed, causing keyboard flow to land on retention first. Found during the keyboard walkthrough.
oliver: That's a regression from the refactor. We should reorder DOM to match visual and add unit tests for logical tab order in the storybook snapshots.
sam: Agreed. I'll swap DOM nodes, wire aria-describedby for the badge, add bottom-sheet for mobile, and update audit CSV generation. Estimate: small patch, PR today.
lina: I'll add e2e tests: 1) tab order matches visual order, 2) SR reads badge aria-label and opens panel, 3) retention shows unit inline and audit CSV has 'change_summary' and reason when provided, 4) color contrast hit for badge.
audit-bot: Audit export schema update recorded. New CSV column 'change_summary' will be added to /exports/audit_csv schema v2.0 at 1945678925.
maya: Thanks. After staging deploy can we run a quick compliance export check and a couple of TTS voice tests for a couple locales (en/fr)?
sam: yes. I'll include staging export and screenshots in the PR.
maya: Great — small but high impact for compliance & accessibility. :thumbsup:
